summary.plain: A cylindrical tank of liquid xenon, chilled and shielded deep in a New Mexico salt mine, that watched for a rare radioactive decay by tracking both light and electric charge from each event.
summary.technical: Cylindrical liquid-xenon time projection chamber, xenon enriched to 80.6% in 136Xe, with combined ionization and scintillation readout; located ~655 m underground at WIPP.

technology.quote: a deep neural network to discriminate between 0νββ and background events
technology.value: Liquid-xenon time projection chamber with combined charge/light readout
